Paragraph: There is none despising him, nor he despised any and for all the living beings he is like the Grandparent Brahma on earth...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Describing the universal benevolence and neutrality of King Dasharatha.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Portraying Dasharatha as a protector loved by all living beings.
Outcome/Resolution: Highlights the noble character of the family.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Dasharatha exemplifies samadrishti, treating all beings with parental care.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Portraying a universally respected figure to evoke safety and high regard.
